messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — EdgeLabs wants a private/on‑prem POC next Tue. They have 4 GPU nodes + 2 control plane nodes. Need us to validate drivers, firmware, kube setup and network egress for the installer. Alan, can you paste node spec and whether these are air-gapped?
alan (EdgeLabs): Not air-gapped, but egress is behind a proxy. Nodes: 4x r750xd with A100 80GB, driver provided by distro currently 470.142, BIOS 2.30, Mellanox CX6 fw 14.29. OS = Ubuntu 22.04. K8s 1.23 (installed last year).
alex: thanks. Two immediate flags: driver 470 is pretty old for A100 80GB; and k8s 1.23 is EOL for many components. We'll need kernel + driver compatibility and potentially bump k8s. Maria, recommended minimums?
maria: For our private installer we recommend: NVIDIA driver >= 525.* (or the latest 535 series for CUDA 12+), CUDA runtime 11.8+ or 12.1, kernel >= 5.15 for ubuntu22.04 but confirm with `uname -r`. k8s: ideally 1.24+ but 1.26 preferred. Also need swap disabled and cgroup v2 or kubelet cgroup driver matched.
sean: also check Secure Boot — driver kernel modules must be signed or Secure Boot disabled. Mellanox FW OK but verify link speeds and offloads.
alan (EdgeLabs): We can upgrade drivers/firmware. Secure Boot currently enabled org-wide. Ops team can disable per-node if needed.
kate: This is the checklist we'll need from EdgeLabs before we can schedule the installer:
- output of `nvidia-smi`
- `uname -r` and `cat /etc/os-release`
- `kubectl get nodes -o wide`
- `lsmod | grep nvidia` and `systemctl status nvidia-persistenced`
- is swap off (`swapon --show`)?
- container runtime (containerd/docker) version + config (`containerd --version` or `docker info`)
- firewall rules / outbound proxy details and ports allowed

Can you run those and paste here, Alan?
alan (EdgeLabs): Pasted a quick run:```
$ uname -r
5.15.0-88-generic
$ cat /etc/os-release
NAME=Ubuntu
VERSION="22.04.3 LTS"
$ nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,driver_version,memory.total --format=csv
A100-SXM4-80GB, 470.142, 81920 MiB
$ swapon --show
# no output (swap off)
$ kubectl get nodes -o wide
NAME        STATUS   ROLES    AGE   VERSION   INTERNAL-IP
ctrl-1      Ready    control  200d  v1.23.5   10.1.0.10
worker-1    Ready    <none>   200d  v1.23.5   10.1.0.21
worker-2    Ready    <none>   200d  v1.23.5   10.1.0.22
worker-3    Ready    <none>   200d  v1.23.5   10.1.0.23
worker-4    Ready    <none>   200d  v1.23.5   10.1.0.24
```
alan (EdgeLabs): containerd 1.6.16, iptables-nft, proxy requiring http proxy env for outbound.
maria: Good. Two action items: (1) plan to upgrade NVIDIA driver to 525+ or 535 series and retest `nvidia-smi`, (2) plan to upgrade k8s control plane and nodes to at least 1.24 (we recommend 1.26 if they can). We can still run installer on 1.23 but we won't support older kubelet features; it may fail CRD/Admission webhook validations.
sean: Networking — installer needs outbound to our endpoint for image pulls and telemetry: ports 443, 8443 (installer), and 443 to model-repo.s3.redwood.ai (or allow via proxy). Also open 22 for ops, and 6443 between control plane nodes. If using Calico/Flannel also ensure IPIP/VXLAN and MTU settings passthrough.
alex: add note: if proxy requires authentication, we need either a proxy user or temporary bypass for installer. Also certs for our private registry if they're using an internal mirror.
kate: Security note: if Secure Boot must remain enabled, ops will need module-signing keys for NVIDIA modules. That adds time. Recommend we schedule a maintenance window to disable/reenable secure boot if possible.
alan (EdgeLabs): Ops prefers not to disable Secure Boot. We'll get the module-signing route. Also Mellanox upgrade is scheduled tomorrow.
maria: Please run these quick validations and paste outputs into this thread so we can mark the preflight green: `nvidia-smi`, `sudo modinfo nvidia | head -n 5`, `kubectl version --short`, `sudo cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version`, `sudo systemctl is-enabled --quiet kubelet && echo kubelet-enabled || echo kubelet-disabled`
alan (EdgeLabs): Will run and return results later tonight.
ops-bot: Ticket #SR-2026 created for EdgeLabs POC preflight — owner: alex. ETA for preflight review: 24h.
alex: thanks — once Alan posts the modinfo and kubelet outputs we'll draft the install runbook and propose Tue 09:00 PT window. :thumbsup:
maria: I'll prepare rollback steps and driver upgrade commands to share (apt + deb vs NVIDIA runfile notes).
sean: also confirm Mellanox driver and that SR-IOV/ENIC offloads are enabled if they expect high throughput.
alan (EdgeLabs): Ok will post full logs. Appreciate the prep — hope to get green by EOD.
alex: perfect. If anything blocks (proxy auth, signed modules) flag it here and we'll escalate with enterprise security.
